views.name: city_product_quarter_sales
views.body_sql: SELECT c.cust_city AS city, p.prod_name AS product, t.calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE s.promo_id IS NULL GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_desc
views.description: total non-promotional sales grouped by city, product, and quarter
